name: Lieutenant Meade

facts.text: Lieutenant Meade, level 50, 5,000 health; Aching Curse lowers the target's melee damage by 21%.
Every named of the Hall takes no damage once drawn past its tether, and walks back to its post.

story: Lieutenant Meade was the one who wrote in the last reports that the men had lost the will to fight and could not say why. He found out. The despair that came up the Summoners' road settled in him first, and now he carries it like a disease: his Aching Curse saps the will of anyone he strikes, so that their blows land a fifth softer. He is the saddest of the watch, and the one most likely to make a raid feel it is losing. When the riders came from Camelot, the dead at this post turned to watch them go, and have watched the door ever since.
legend: His curse cuts your melee damage by about a fifth. Cure it if you can, rotate melee if you cannot, and kill him at his post before the despair spreads to the whole front line. The watch fights better together: clear the posts nearest it first.

aggro: Why fight? Why does anyone fight?

lairEntry: The air here is heavy. Your arms feel tired.
atmosphere.realmFirstKill: Lieutenant Meade is released from the watch.
